name: emberfield
label: Emberfield
tagline: Farm the valley, raid the wilds

help.about: Farm a valley through the seasons, get to know the town, and raid the wilds for what the farm cannot grow. You choose how hard death is when you start a valley.

manifest.summary: A pixel farming and adventure game: grow a seeded valley, sell and craft, walk to the town, and fight down the cave mouth at night. Content (items, recipes, sounds) is data in ~/ForgeGameData, art in ~/ForgeArtData, saves in ~/EmberfieldData.

features.name: Farm and seasons
features.description: Till, plant, water and sleep to grow crops; days turn into four 28-day seasons, and a fall or a night's sleep both turn the day the same way.

features.name: Town and people
features.description: A road out to a town, a village and two farmsteads where seven people keep a daily schedule and talk; every house can be walked into.

features.name: Wilds and death rules
features.description: A torchlit cavern that is different every day and worse at night; dying follows the rule chosen per valley (soft, character or full permadeath, which deletes the save and never writes it back).

features.name: Crafting, cooking and a chest
features.description: Workbench and hearth recipes from data, tool upgrades that work a 3x3, and a chest the save remembers.

features.name: Eating
features.description: Press e when hurt to eat the smallest carried meal that fills your hearts; how much a food heals is its optional heals field (or its sell price / 30). The HUD shows the food you carry.

features.name: Named valleys and a tidy save list
features.description: Name a new valley on the title screen; saves list newest first with day, season, gold, death rule and how long ago, and a new valley always starts on day 1.

features.name: Settings, simple and advanced
features.description: Day length, zoom and sound are sliders paired with number boxes; the world-model and voice experiments and the background-core budget sit under Advanced, which stays open once used.

features.name: Smooth inside the hub
features.description: Dark from the first frame with a loading card, one frame loop, the HUD redrawn only when it changes, and fully paused (no frames, timers or fetches, audio suspended) while the hub hides it.

manifest.data_dir: ~/EmberfieldData (saves, settings, voice cache); content in ~/ForgeGameData, art in ~/ForgeArtData
known_gaps: Not yet played by hand at normal day length after the 2026-10-19 sweep; checks were headless Chrome only, not the Forge WebKitGTK window.
